Markus / team — adding a quick technical note on the two clarifications.

1) Data residency / hot KV caches:
- Customer payloads are served from region-specific inference pools. Hot KV caches for short-term session state are pinned to the same region as the inference GPU pool and are deleted on session TTL expiry (typically 1h). Long-term logging (audit/observation) is replicated to our US central analytics region for platform observability only; customer data residency controls are configurable per account.

2) Subcontractor attestations:
- We maintain SOC 2 Type II reports for our hosted control plane vendor (SecureCloudOps) and provide those reports on request under NDA. For inferencing GPU providers, we maintain contractual security obligations plus monthly attestation summaries. Where a subcontractor has no formal attestation, we provide control statements and contractual clauses.

Attached: Redwood_SIG_Mapping.pdf (preliminary mapping), Evidence_Index_Template.csv

I'll prepare the SIG-level mapping (SIG-C -> RW-CTRL-XXXX) and include direct evidence pointers (Drive links or presigned S3). Expect the mapping PDF by end of day Tuesday Nov 24.

-Neha Kapoor
Sr. Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
